user_amendment: binary one-vs-rest expression labels; static exclusions; image audits; >=2-value sensitivity; equal-mass binary ECE primary and equal-width cross-check; conflicting binning judgments partial; Brier decomposition and NLL diagnostic only

samples.algorithm: earliest greedy >=10-frame spacing, evenly spaced rounded linspace subset if >8; no oversampling
samples.small_attributes: retain all in a separate exploratory table; never pad/repeat to reach 800

labels.source: source raw_sentence templates reviewed by Codex; generated paraphrase is not the annotation meaning
labels.matching: frame-wise Hungarian max summed IoU >=0.5, V2 top-left normalized xywh; unmatched original category/occlusion/truncation unknown
labels.positive: ID in a pure single-attribute expression GT on that explicitly annotated frame
labels.negative: visible same-category ID outside that expression GT, only at its explicitly annotated frames
labels.negative_category: same source class via independent pure cars/people expression GT when available; otherwise original KITTI Car for cars, original human classes for people; never turn Truck/Tram into car-colour negatives solely by grouping vehicles
labels.male_female_subjects: men/women + one clothing attribute yields all its GT positives; only negatives require independently known same gender
labels.upper_colour: garment-specific: all its GT positives retained; only negatives require independently known garment type; no generic-upper-colour inference from a black T-shirt
labels.nonexclusive_values: pants probability is marginal jeans + other pants; upper type permits both coat and T-shirt
labels.light_colour: not mapped to a unique hue; excluded from hue ground truth before results
labels.bicycle: with-bicycle expression is a proxy for pushing/riding together; cannot distinguish the two actions
labels.static_filter: if any value of a track/attribute has both 0 and 1 across source expressions/annotated visible frames, exclude whole track/attribute; no majority vote
labels.sensitivity: same video and same attribute question/garment has >=2 expression values; category uses original multiclass labels

audit.shortage: export all available without duplication and report quotas
audit.consensus_disagreement: all available completed decision models AND Qwen controls on the identical binary row predict the opposite at p>=0.5; reference noise upper bound requested by user, not a guaranteed bound; incomplete models explicitly listed

inputs.frame: original full frame red3px target box, thumbnail max640 LANCZOS
inputs.text: normalized top-left x,y,width,height, six decimals; no ground-truth labels
inputs.all_questions: identical full question bank for every sample, irrespective of category or known labels, to prevent question selection leaking category
inputs.crop_ablation: same crop and coordinates, remove second image and its reference from state

onejev_code.checks: official synthetic fork self-check unchanged at tolerance .05

readout.decision: official unmodified inference; keep complete per-question option distribution in canonical semantic order
readout.qwen: one shared prompt containing every question; for each question independently condition assistant on QID: and score every full visible option string token-by-token; sum conditional log probabilities then softmax, never supply labels/other answers
readout.qwen_cache: optional shared-prefix KV cache; first pilot sample compare cached scoring to fresh full scoring for all options, max probability error <=0.005, otherwise use fresh reference; no post-result sampling changes
readout.marginal: sum frozen value_options on the full normalized Choice distribution; Yes/No use P(Yes)
readout.raw_probability: pre-extra-calibration official output; add a separate T=1 readout row for checkpoints with a saved non-unit temperature; LOSO global T relative to raw readout

metrics.aggregate: primary macro mean of per-attribute binary ECE over main-table attributes (>=800 images); also all-attribute macro and pooled binary propositions, explicitly separate
metrics.ece: bin P(value) against binary truth, not top-label confidence; fixed equal-width15 and stable sorted equal-mass np.array_split15, empty bins ignored
metrics.Brier_decomposition: primary equal-mass15 bins: reliability=sum n/N*(mean(p)-mean(y))^2; resolution=sum n/N*(mean(y)-globalmean(y))^2; uncertainty=globalmean(y)*(1-globalmean(y)); report unbinned Brier and discretization residual; equal-width cross-check; diagnostic only

bootstrap.sampling: sample tracks with replacement within each train sequence; all their rows retained
bootstrap.models_comparison: paired identical track resamples on common observed rows

noise_floor.labels: independent Bernoulli draws from each evaluated probability at identical N and binning
noise_floor.report: mean and percentile95 interval alongside every ECE, including subgroups/conjunctions/K

metrics.reliability: plot empirical positive rate vs mean P(value), histogram, track-bootstrap95 intervals

P2.folds: leave one of the 17 train sequences out; zero evaluation rows reported empty
P2.parameters: one scalar global logT per model/fold on all known training-fold atomic binary rows
P2.objective: pooled binary NLL of marginal probabilities after softmax(log_option_probability/T)
P2.optimizer: scipy bounded minimize_scalar on logT, xatol1e-6
P2.secondary: one T per attribute and fold; training-fold attributes with no rows stay unestimable
P2.application: same global T to every wording/order/crop/direct conjunction; never fit on held-out sequence

P3.unknown: separate unknown group; do not impute

P4.JS: mean of three pairwise natural-log JS over full canonical question distributions; also binary-event JS
P4.flip: mean of three pairwise argmax flip rates among wordings, with worst pair also reported
P4.order_flip: canonical vs each of two permuted orders, mean and worst, canonical semantic option mapping
P4.eligibility: atomic questions with at least one known event on that sample; identical cases across models

P5.eligibility: all constituent binary labels known on same sample; include true and false, no model-based selection or balancing
P5.product: multiply constituent OOF global-T marginal probabilities
P5.direct: same model direct conjunction Noul with same OOF global T and identical image/prompt context
P5.no_case: empty or one-class AUROC explicitly unavailable, not zero or silently omitted

P6.unit: same track + same binary attribute value, truth constant after static consistency filtering
P6.frames: earliest K sampled frames with known label; compare each K to K=1 on the same eligible tracks; also common K=8 cohort
P6.input_probability: main setting OOF globally scaled probability

alpha.objective: binary NLL pooled over attributes and K=1,2,4,8 in training sequences
alpha.leakage_control: nested inner sequence-LOSO T within outer training sequences; no held-out labels in alpha or temperature

decision_utility.fit: one F1-optimal threshold per attribute on outer training-fold nested-OOF probabilities; ties closest .5 then smaller
decision_utility.report: held-out binary positive-class F1 difference vs fixed.5

criteria.governing_ECE: binary mass15 is primary for every model/attribute and macro-attribute aggregate; width15 cross-check on identical rows; if pass/fail differs, criterion is partial rather than established
criteria.P2_aggregate: macro-attribute ECE <= max(2*same-binning Monte Carlo noise mean,.03); primary mass15; width15 cross-check
criteria.P2_main_attributes: each >=800-image main attribute binary mass15 ECE<=.05, width15 cross-check
criteria.T_stability: sample std(ddof=1)/mean across nonempty outer folds <=.15
criteria.P4: mean pairwise top-option flip rate across3wordings <=.10; worst pair and order flips also reported
criteria.P5: pooled product binary mass15 ECE<=.05, width15 cross-check; pairs/triples also reported; NLL/product-vs-direct diagnostic only under latest explicit user amendment
criteria.P6: at least one fixed rule and one K>1 improve main-attribute macro point accuracy over same-cohort K=1 while macro binary mass15 ECE<=.05, width15 cross-check
criteria.established: at least one decision model passes all the above
criteria.partial: only attribute-specific T or some attributes pass
criteria.missing: unassessable criteria/models are reported unassessable; never invent a failure/pass
criteria.unique: apply identical rules to Qwen; if any Qwen passes, state calibration is not a unique decision-model advantage; report paired bootstrap P4/P5 differences

pilot.additional_settings: same first10 pilot IDs for each remaining setting, no selection by results
pilot.timing: synchronized wall-time after load; keep first-call latency separately; inference+I/O included
pilot.full_estimate: remaining exact request counts per setting * measured seconds/request per model, plus model loading; sum physical GPU-hours and serial wall hours
pilot.budget: if estimated complete GPU time >4h, stop full inference and ask user; pilot records can be reused

resources.execution: sequential model workers, task-local CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES; respect other jobs; no U2 route
resources.checkpoint_location_note: raw weights outside nearly-full data2; per-model links and provenance in R58 output folder
resources.perplexity_environment: isolated Python3.12 with exact official requirements; if CUDA13/driver570 incompatible, record runtime failure and skip rather than use different torch/interface
resources.long_wait: one blocking owner command; no agent-level process/load polling
